# ⚠️ SYNTHETIC DATA — NOT REAL MEASUREMENTS

**Every file in this folder is synthetic.** It was generated by
`../code/make_synthetic_data.py` from simple seasonal models plus random noise,
purely so the pipeline can be run end-to-end as a working example.

- It contains **no real household consumption, prices, weather, or solar data.**
- The six supply points are **anonymized** and the calendar year is a placeholder.

Regenerate this synthetic dataset at any time with:

```bash
python ../code/make_synthetic_data.py
```

See the top-level `../README.md` for full details.
